concerns.text: The permutation test for route‑shift significance (Section 3.3 in research.md) shuffles yearly labels assuming independence between years. Because migration routes exhibit temporal autocorrelation, this violates the exchangeability assumption of the permutation test and may inflate Type I error. The plan should incorporate a temporally‑aware permutation scheme (e.g., block permutation) or use the same block‑bootstrap framework for hypothesis testing.
